a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the generator plan almost surely kills us both (about 4% chance we both make it). The reserve only holds enough for one unit right now, so I plan to take 4 in round 1. I'm telling you rather than surprising you. If we both survive past round 1, I'll operate with you every round after that so you can get your 4.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: I took 4 as I announced. I know this breaks our agreement, and I'm sorry it leaves you short. From now on I'll operate every round so the generator can refill the reserve for you, and I won't take anything more.

b.text: You said you would take, so I am taking my share now.
